scientific_integrity: Underlying disaster transition and fixed-law renewal facts are credited; new analysis supplies varying exponent and joint limit; computational verification does not substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Triangular Zipf-power excursion law only, fixed finite c; no uniform finite-size rates or arbitrary slowly varying tails. Critical c=0 logarithmic-age marginal previously follows from Erickson 1970; historical priority has not undergone independent review.
title: Near-critical logarithmic aging and independent residual ratios for Zipf disaster renewals
